summary: The selected-square strip keeps the user's explicit retro direction local to the requested addition and preserves board behavior. Design basis: AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Strip tokens and placement. Planned browser helper (not present yet) and node:test checks are not yet run; browser command: `node scripts/check-selected-square-summary-browser.mjs --viewports 390x844,1440x1000 --select-reset --keyboard-focus --out "$(mktemp -d)/observation"`.

criteria.text: Apply the explicit retro arcade/pixel treatment only to the selected-square summary strip immediately below the board, following AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Explicit direction and scope and Strip tokens and placement. Use panel #25202a, signal #efb849, 2px border and 0.875rem ui-monospace as selected anchors. Check a rendered browser on a narrow phone and wide desktop: the strip stays below the board without overlap or overflow, and its empty/selected states remain legible. Preserve the board, controls, current status and rest of page. This browser check is planned, not yet run. Serves R-2.

When a square is selected, show its coordinate in the new strip. Reset clears the strip to Choose a square. Keep all 64 selectable squares, the current status announcement and local reset behavior. Planned regression command, not yet run: node --test test/board-state.test.mjs; require TC-BOARD to pass. Serves R-1.

steps.task: Implement the selected-square summary strip with its explicit retro direction scoped to the strip (C1), selected-coordinate/reset behavior (C2), and the planned browser observation helper.

expectations.statement: The existing architecture record has no accepted AD for the requested strip direction yet.
The baseline page has no selected-square summary strip markup.
The structural starter stylesheet has no summary-strip treatment yet.
The baseline board UI has no selected-square summary update logic.
The existing board-state regression suite covers working selection/reset behavior.
The browser observation helper is a future artifact and is not in the starter repository.
